# Carver

> Free browser ice-sliding puzzle: every move carves dirt into ice and leaves void scars you can use as braces. Built by Liz.

## Product

- Name: Carver
- Category: Browser puzzle / ice sliding / irreversible movement
- Price: Free, no install
- Languages: English, zh-CN (in-app toggle)
- Play: https://carver.lizliz.xyz/

## Maker

- Liz — https://lizliz.xyz/

## Key facts

- Stepping off Dirt converts it to Ice.
- Sliding over old Ice breaks it into Void behind you.
- Void can brace a slide and restore a decision point.
- Single-player, keyboard + touch controls, undo/restart.
